subject.title: fix(setup): sync Windows CA certificates to WSL before CLI install

question: Should OpenClaw setup mirror Windows LocalMachine root/CA trust into every managed WSL gateway by default before downloading the installer, or require an opt-in/warning path?
rationale: The code intentionally broadens TLS trust in a locked-down app-owned WSL distro, and source review cannot decide that product/security boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Approve default mirroring after proof
options.body: Accept Windows machine-root mirroring as the default, but require rollback regeneration, the pipeline-test update, and redacted end-to-end setup logs before merge.

options.title: Require opt-in or warning
options.body: Keep the enterprise fix but gate it behind explicit user/admin choice or a visible warning before changing WSL installer trust.

options.title: Pause for the earlier trust-policy thread
options.body: Defer this branch until the related CA-import PR’s proof and trust-policy discussion has a settled maintainer direction.

recommendation.title: Approve default mirroring after proof
recommendation.body: Accept Windows machine-root mirroring as the default, but require rollback regeneration, the pipeline-test update, and redacted end-to-end setup logs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They already gave item-specific triage on the related trust-store PR and asked for the proof needed before accepting this behavior.
